items.title: Broadcom’s 2027 Bull Case: AI Revenue Doubles to $115B and $230B—Here’s What Finally Unlocks the Stock
items.summary: Broadcom's AI chip business is exploding, yet the stock keeps sliding while Wall Street piles on bullish targets. A bold 2027 scenario hinges on a few customer ramps and one valuation shift, and the math may surprise skeptics.

items.title: Broadcom Makes More AI Money Than AMD—So Why Is AMD’s Stock Crushing It?
items.summary: One chip giant books far more AI revenue, yet its stock sinks while its smaller rival soars. Investors are betting on a growth curve, but cash flow, inventory, and a December earnings date could change who looks smarter.

items.title: He was right about AI and still lost $35 billion
items.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner turned $225 million into a $45 billion fund in under two years by betting on everything AI would need. Then 4x leverage and a brutal July cost him $35 billion from the peak. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down the essay, the bets, the margin calls and Citadel's block trade, and whether he can run it back.

items.title: Amazon Blocked Meta’s Muse Two Months Ago. Now It’s in Talks to Let It Shop, and Walmart Already Did
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFortune reported that Amazon and Meta are in talks to let Meta’s Muse agent shop on Amazon, two months after Amazon blocked it. Walmart already lets Muse shop its Black Friday deals, and Shopify signed on as a Muse partner early, so Amazon is the big holdout.

items.title: Meta launches AI shopping agent Muse in UK
items.summary: Meta has launched its Muse personal AI agent in the UK, offering fashion shoppers a new way to search for products, organise tasks, and manage selected purchases.

items.title: How Much Of Big Tech's AI Spending Reaches Nvidia?
items.summary: You may have read that about half of each dollar Big Tech spends on AI ends up at Nvidia. Our own articles have said so too. That number is a ratio, not a measurement. Our estimate, built from what the companies report, puts the real share closer to a quarter.

items.title: Is Meta Stock a Buy as Amazon Reportedly Weighs Letting Its AI Shopping Agent Back In?
items.summary: A deal would bring Muse back into Amazon's store. But Muse's shopping fees are still just a plan.

items.title: AMD's Data Center Business Leads Growth: Can the Momentum Continue?
items.summary: AMD's Data Center revenues surge 97% to a record $8.55 billion, but can strong EPYC demand, Instinct GPUs and Helios systems sustain the growth momentum?
